review_candidates.description_excerpt: Establish and maintain firewall policy, segmentation standards, change control and configuration documentation for all sites and data centers. Define network operations and monitoring requirements for our managed service provider, participate in vendor selection, and oversee the provider’s network services against agreed service levels. WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications).
eligibility_evidence: You will consolidate a multi-vendor environment onto a unified Fortinet platform, take full ownership of network infrastructure across nine international sites and two data centers, and shape how the network is run for years to come.
Lead site migrations, serving as the on-site technical lead for Monterrey and remote lead for international locations.
Support the separation of our colocation data centers and the subsequent migration of workloads to AWS, including hybrid connectivity to Azure and AWS.
Required: 7+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including at least 3 years as the senior or lead engineer for a multi-site international WAN.
